events.label: US nonfarm payrolls
events.note: The largest scheduled mover of the dollar and the 10-year there is, and it moves both in the same print. Two live channels on this desk repriced at 18:00 IST, after the Indian close.

events.label: China CPI and PPI
events.note: PPI is the one that matters here. Chinese factory-gate deflation is exported straight into the metal complex.

events.label: China trade data
events.note: Import volumes for crude and for copper: the demand side of two of this desk's channels in a single release.

events.label: US crude inventories (EIA)
events.note: Weekly stock change. A draw larger than expected lifts crude for the session; a build does the reverse.

events.label: India CPI
events.note: Released after the close, before the next open -- so the gap risk sits outside the session the band was computed for. Food is roughly 46% of the basket, which is what ties this to the agri channel.

events.label: US CPI
events.note: The rate path, and therefore the discount rate on long-duration India. The BLS sets the exact date and it moves within the second week, so treat this one as a week rather than a day until confirmed.

events.label: China activity data
events.note: Industrial production, retail sales and fixed-asset investment together. Fixed-asset investment is the construction read, and construction is what iron ore and copper are actually a bet on.

events.label: US retail sales
events.note: Consumer demand. Matters here only when it is far enough from expectation to move the rate path.

events.label: US crude inventories (EIA)
events.note: Weekly stock change. A draw larger than expected lifts crude for the session; a build does the reverse.

events.label: MCX Crude oil expiry
events.note: The front contract settles. The desk rolls three days earlier; the strip already shows the next.

events.label: PBoC loan prime rate
events.note: The policy rate. Moves the yuan, and the yuan is the currency the metal complex takes its cue from when the dollar is quiet.

events.label: US crude inventories (EIA)
events.note: Weekly stock change. A draw larger than expected lifts crude for the session; a build does the reverse.

events.label: China NBS PMI
events.note: Sets the tone for the entire metal channel at once -- copper, aluminium and iron ore all price off Chinese industrial demand. Published on the last day of the month whatever day that falls on, so it often lands on a weekend and is priced at the next open.

events.label: China Caixin Manufacturing PMI
events.note: The private survey, weighted to smaller and more export-facing firms. When it disagrees with the NBS print, the disagreement is the signal.

events.label: US ISM Manufacturing
events.note: The global growth proxy the dollar trades off. Also the cleanest read on whether the copper move is demand or positioning.

events.label: US crude inventories (EIA)
events.note: Weekly stock change. A draw larger than expected lifts crude for the session; a build does the reverse.

events.label: US ISM Services
events.note: The larger half of the US economy and the smaller half of the dollar's reaction to it.
